text.p: CyberOptics Corp said on Friday it expected revenue and net income for the quarter ended September 30 to be lower than the expectations of analysts and operations might generate a small loss during the quarter.

The company said in a statement that it attributed the lower revenue and earnings to overcapacity and inventory levels in the semiconductor and electronics industry the company supplies and to expenses related to a 10 percent reduction in staff during the quarter.
President Steven Case said, "We are more optimistic for the prospects in the electronics industry during the fourth quarter of 1996."
The company reported a profit of $1.3 million, or $0.27 a share, on revenues of $8.2 million in the third quarter of 1995.
